children: Avio Smart Market Stack Limited (ASMS), formerly Bartronics India Limited, and Ampivo Smart Technologies will roll out Agri Kisan Setu app, developed by the latter, in the village network groomed by the former.
The app provides market price information, buyer-seller connectivity, agricultural tutorials, government-scheme information and access to services such as drone operations.
Available on the Google Play Store in seven languages, the app is being used in villages covered by Ampivo’s farmer training and pilot programmes, the companies said in a statement on Thursday.

The proposed rollout follows a memorandum of understanding between the companies. It will initially focus on enrolling farmers for the platform’s existing agricultural, knowledge and marketplace services.

Ampivo is also developing features to help farmers identify relevant government schemes and participate in eligible carbon-credit programmes, including digital measurement, reporting and verification.

title: ASMS, Ampivo plan rural rollout of farm services app
